note: FORMAT FIXTURE — 20 assertion records on the synthetic paper in examples/synthetic_paper.txt. This is not a real paper and these are not claims from the literature; they exist to show the record shape and the quality flags. Evidence addresses are page + verbatim quote; paragraph ids are abbreviated. Three relations here (`describes`, `holds`, `disappears`) are outside references/relations.json on purpose: at runtime an unmapped relation must carry the quality_flag relation_unmapped, and this fixture shows the vocabulary gap rather than hiding it.

paper.title: Sparse Expert Routing Under a Fixed Compute Budget (synthetic fixture)

assertions.object: inference cost

evidence.quote: Sparse expert routing reduces inference cost while preserving accuracy in large language models.
